# glinet_arp_entries (Data Source)

Get the ARP table of the router (`network.get_arp_list`). The entries change while the router runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_arp_entries" "arp" {}

output "lan_neighbor_ips" {
  value = [for e in data.glinet_arp_entries.arp.entries : e.ip if e.device == "br-lan"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) ARP entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `device` (String) Network device of the entry, for example `br-lan`.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address.
- `mac` (String) MAC address.
